translations.name: Original
translations.attribution: Solomon ibn Gabirol; historical Hebrew translation by Judah Ibn Tibbon; Hebrew Wikisource contributors (see revision history); English translation by Stephen S. Wise, 1902, via Sefaria.
translations.changes: Selected and resegmented Hebrew passages and paired 39 with corresponding passages from the separately edited Wise English version; retained further paragraphs from five unfinished Wikisource pages without English alignment. Source segments were joined and split at reviewed paragraph boundaries; relevant English headings and heading notes were omitted. No original translation or new OCR was produced.

translations.coverageStatus: Partial medieval Hebrew translation by Judah Ibn Tibbon from five cited Wikisource pages, each marked unfinished. The pages contain text under all twenty topics, but whole-work completeness and proofreading are not established. 39 passages in selected topics are paired with Wise’s 1902 English; remaining Hebrew passages are not paired here. The Judeo-Arabic original is not included. These are different translations, with variants and omissions.
